text:
laura-gtd: Quick idea for private-offer pilot: offer a 12mo split-commit where the first 6mo is 'onramp guaranteed' (consumption-backed credit) and months 7-12 are true committed dollars. Aim: lower initial procurement friction for appliance + SI bundles. thoughts?

 tom-cloud: Love the idea. For hyperscalers we should make the onramp credits non-transferable and tie to region. Suggest bands: Starter=25k (3% off), Growth=100k (8%), Scale=350k (15%). Onramp credit = up to 40% of first 2 months consumption, capped at $20k.

 mike-accounts: Accounting note: credits that offset consumption should appear as contra-revenue on invoices, we need GL mapping. Also need a clawback if they cancel within 120d.

 sana-partnerops: SI ask: allow SIs to claim a one-time implementation bonus of 7% of appliance SKU if deployment completes within 45 days. We will require a deployment proof doc.

 olivia-legal: @sana-partnerops @mike-accounts we need to define "deployment proof" (screenshot + signed acceptance) and the clawback conditions. I'll prepare language that supports a 120d clawback and a recovery process via invoice adjustments.

 laura-gtd: Mechanics I propose: onramp credit becomes a spend-credit at renewal if usage >=75% of projected. If not converted, the credit is treated as a non-refundable marketing credit (no cash). Also include a 3mo renewal nudge credit (5% of next term) if they commit within 30d after renewal offer.

 tom-cloud: Operational tags we'll need: region:appliance, offer:split-commit, pilot:true, si-partner-id. Ops team can surface these in meter logs.

 mike-accounts: Can we put a simple quote snippet?

 ```
 OFFER_SNIPPET:
  TERM: 12 months (6m onramp + 6m committed)
  BANDS: Starter(25k)->3% | Growth(100k)->8% | Scale(350k)->15%
  ONRAMP_CREDIT: 40% of month1-2 consumption, cap $20,000
  SI_BONUS: 7% of APPL SKU after 45d validated deployment
  RENEWAL_NUDGE: 5% credit if renewed within 30d of offer expiration
 ```

 sana-partnerops: Pilot logistics: prefer single-market run (EMEA telco partner) for 8 weeks. We'll enroll 6 customers and collect adoption metrics. SI needs to consent to separate PS invoices.

 laura-gtd: Also add a small 'conversion accelerator' for the SI: if customer reaches 90% of projected by month4, SI gets an extra 3% rev share. That should incent active enablement.

 olivia-legal: Heads up: any "rev share" wording triggers partnership revenue recognition checks. Finance signoff required. I'll coordinate with finance.

 mike-accounts: Finance check: rev share payments must be processed as partner payouts with proper VAT handling; allow 30d payout window after proof acceptance.

 tom-cloud: Implementation checklist for infra:
 1) new offer tag in billing service
 2) onramp credit token support + expiry rules
 3) SI payout pipeline with proof attach
 4) reporting dashboard for pilot metrics
Est time: 3 sprints if prioritized.

 laura-gtd: Pilot timeline proposal: start pilot kickoff May 6, check at week3 and week6, end pilot June 30. Deliverables: pilot brief, quote templates, legal clause, billing instrumentation.

 pilot-bot: Pilot task created: pilot-split-commit-emea-174. Checkpoint reminders set for 2024-05-27 and 2024-06-17.

 sana-partnerops: I'll pull the candidate customer list and SI deployment timelines this week.

 olivia-legal: Draft clause: I'll circulate a 1-page candidate clause with clawback and proof rules by Friday.

 laura-gtd: Great team. If we agree on numbers, I'll prep a one-slide GTM playbook + sample quote and pin it here. Exclude regulated gov accounts from pilot.

 tom-cloud: excluding govcloud noted.

 mike-accounts: ok from accounting perspective pending GL mapping work.

 laura-gtd: tagging this thread as canonical for the pilot setup. Will post slide and sample quote once legal and finance sign off. :rocket:

 pilot-bot: Thread pinned to #partnerships channel by laura-gtd.
